newsitem.title: USA: Cameron Ashley to acquire Ince unit assets.
newsitem.headline: Cameron Ashley to acquire Ince unit assets.

text.p: Cameron Ashley Building Products Inc said Monday that it plans to acquire certain assets of Boyd Distributor, a roofing and insulation materials distributor that is a unit of Ince Holdings Ltd.
Cameron said it had signed a letter of intent to acquire Boyd in a deal that would be accretive to its overall earnings.

The acquisition would be for cash and would be for about 20 million Canadian dollars, said John Davis, Cameron's vice president and general counsel. It is tentatively scheduled to close at the end of January, Davis said.
Davis said Ince Holding is a private Canadian company whose parent company is Duke Seabridge Ltd. Cameron Ashley Building is a building products distributor with 108 branches in the United States.
